About these names

Nordic names are compound words: two meaningful roots welded together. Sig (victory) + rid (rider) gives Sigrid; Thor + stein gives Thorstein. Male names commonly end -ar, -ulf or -stein; female names -dis, -hild, -run or -veig. This is the register Skyrim borrows almost wholesale.
